clue.text: High pitched sound likely at first in buzzer and piano

clue.text: Carol King

clue.text: Use upside-down cross carved into oak, say

clue.text: Diva in front of choir upset Leonardo

explanation.definitionFit: A Sea Breeze is a mixed drink of vodka with cranberry and grapefruit juice.

clue.text: Last in Henley, German eight's boat
